command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP 1: sudoers directive for syslog facility"
cat > /tmp/99-sudo-logging <<'EOF'
Defaults syslog=local2
Defaults syslog_goodpri=notice
EOF
visudo -cf /tmp/99-sudo-logging
sudo -n install -m 0440 -o root -g root /tmp/99-sudo-logging /etc/sudoers.d/99-sudo-logging
sudo -n visudo -c

echo "STEP 2: rsyslog rule to capture local2 into dedicated file and stop further processing"
cat > /tmp/49-sudo-commands.conf <<'EOF'
local2.*    /var/log/sudo-commands.log
local2.*    stop
EOF
sudo -n install -m 0644 -o root -g root /tmp/49-sudo-commands.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/49-sudo-commands.conf

echo "STEP 3: pre-create log file with sane perms"
sudo -n touch /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo -n chmod 0600 /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo -n chown root:root /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "STEP 4: restart rsyslog"
sudo -n systemctl restart rsyslog
sleep 1
sudo -n systemctl is-active rsyslog

echo "STEP 5: capture baseline size of /var/log/messages and sudo-commands.log"
sudo -n wc -l /var/log/messages /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "STEP 6: generate a distinctive sudo command to test logging"
sudo -n whoami
sleep 2

echo "STEP 7: verify entry landed in sudo-commands.log with user+timestamp"
sudo -n tail -5 /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "STEP 8: verify it did NOT land in /var/log/messages"
sudo -n grep -c "sudo:" /var/log/messages || echo "0 sudo entries in messages (expected)"
